title: Childhood as Foundation, Not Resume
primary_theme: Missionary FinTech Founders and Personal Origin Stories
founder_lessons: Solve a big problem tied closely enough to your life that failure does not feel optional.
Tell the story before the resume; formative experiences often reveal founder motivation and grit.
Measure impact outcomes, not just good intentions.
Choose capital partners who will stay with you through thick and thin.
notable_quotes: we think we can make better than market returns by investing in stuff that are arguably philanthropic
we always ask people to start at their date of birth, not at their resume
Solve a big problem. Life's too short.
